rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for judging a value, amount, ability, importance, or difficulty too low.

example.english: If we rely only on this report, we underestimate the repair costs.
example.traditional: 我哋淨係靠呢份報告，就會低估維修工程嘅成本。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zing6 hai6 kaau3 ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zau6 wui6 dai1 gu2 wai4 sau1 gung1 cing4 ge3 sing4 bun2

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice especially when underestimating a person, group, or thing's ability or significance.

example.english: Don't underestimate him; he can move the table by himself.
example.traditional: 你唔好睇小佢，佢一個人都搬得郁張枱。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 dou1 bun1 dak1 juk1 zoeng1 ci5

rows.note: Use this when treating a task, problem, or matter as less important or difficult than it really is.

example.english: If we underestimate this problem, it will take us all night to sort it out.
example.traditional: 我哋如果睇輕呢個問題，就要搞成晚先掂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jyu4 gwo2 tai2 heng1 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 zau6 jiu3 gaau2 seng4 maan5 sin1 dim6
